'''Vacher''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of the [[Blood Razors]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Biivren]]. He was second in command to [[Shirro]].
He collected money for the gang from sympathetic citizens and brokered deals with outsiders, such as [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. His job was to keep the gang well equipped. He spent most of his time hanging out in [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] near the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] attempting to find people able to smuggle contraband. Vahcer was born on Biivren and was intimately familiar with the layout of the area, including shortcuts and hidden passageways.
